site.introduction: I am a scholar of ancient scripture and the Latter-day Saint religious tradition. My research explores the Hebrew Bible, ancient Egypt, Restoration scripture, and Latter-day Saint history.

home.bio_primary: Stephen O. Smoot holds a doctorate in Semitic and Egyptian Languages and Literature from the Catholic University of America. He previously earned a master’s degree in Near and Middle Eastern Civilizations, with a concentration in Egyptology, from the University of Toronto, and bachelor’s degrees in Ancient Near Eastern Studies (Hebrew Bible emphasis) and German Studies from Brigham Young University.
home.bio_secondary: Stephen currently serves as an adjunct instructor of ancient scripture at Brigham Young University and as a research associate with the Ancient America Foundation. From 2020 to 2025, he was a research associate with the B. H. Roberts Foundation, and from 2015 to 2020, he held the same role with Book of Mormon Central.

cv.profile: My academic and professional work centers on the study of ancient scripture and the Latter-day Saint religious tradition, with particular interests in Egyptology, biblical studies, and the history, doctrine, and scripture of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Below is an overview of my academic training, research, publications, teaching, and professional experience.

experience.title: Research Associate
experience.description: Conducts interdisciplinary research on the Book of Mormon and other books of Latter-day Saint scripture, as well as research on the history and doctrine of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

experience.title: Adjunct Instructor
experience.description: Teaches undergraduate courses in ancient scripture, emphasizing historical context, interpretation/hermeneutics, and the religious and cultural backgrounds of Latter-day Saint history and scriptural traditions.

experience.title: Research Associate
experience.description: Conducted historical research on a variety of topics related to Latter-day Saint scripture and history, contributing to scholarly publications and educational resources.

experience.title: Research Associate
experience.organization: Book of Mormon Central / Scripture Central
experience.description: Researched and produced scholarly and educational content on the Book of Mormon and the Pearl of Great Price, drawing on biblical studies, Egyptology, ancient Near Eastern studies, Mesoamerican studies, and Latter-day Saint history.
